description: The scheduling and workflow-engine surface: the top-level orchestration block and build.execution's inline orchestration twin (engine/mode), build.execution's trigger (type, dataset references, datasetsOperator), and the Airflow-specific shapes reached through orchestration.airflow -- airflowOrchestration's dagId/dagConfig/taskDefaults/errorHandling/tasks/taskGroups, airflowTask's identifier and type-taxonomy fields plus its five conditional allOf branches (provider_action, fluid_execute, bash, python), and airflowSensor. A conformant implementation reproduces every verdict below.
